enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping quietly in his own room with the fan on low, phone alarms set for the study day ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on his back on the bed under the blanket. Close his eyes. Turn onto his right side. Pull the blanket up to his shoulder. Breathe slowly and evenly. Turn onto his left side. Adjust the pillow under his head. Turn onto his back again. Stretch his right arm out from under the blanket. Pull the arm back under the blanket. Bend both knees briefly. Straighten his legs. Turn onto his right side again. Keep the bedroom door closed. Keep the fan running on low. Keep the phone on the bedside table with alarms set. Remain in bed until the first alarm.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly, turning on the light, and checking his written to-do list and shift roster notes on his phone
enriched_activities.desc: Open his eyes. Turn onto his back. Push the blanket down to his waist. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Reach to the bedside table. Press the lamp switch to turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the phone. Press the screen to wake it. Open the shift roster note application. Scroll down the roster list. Press the home button. Pick up the paper to-do list from the bedside table. Read the list top to bottom. Put the paper list back down on the bedside table. Put the phone back down. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, shaving and dressing in clean clothes for university
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Step inside. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Test the water temperature with his hand. Turn the tap to adjust the temperature. Step into the shower. Wet his hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into his palm. Wash his hair. Put the shampoo bottle down. Pick up the soap. Lather his body. Rinse off under the water. Turn off the tap. Step out onto the bath mat. Pick up the towel. Dry his hair. Dry his body. Wrap the towel around his waist. Wipe the mirror with his hand. Pick up the razor. Shave his face. Rinse the razor under the tap. Wipe his face with the towel. Pick up the clean clothes he carried in. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing his backpack, checking his placement handover notes and confirming travel times on his phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to Bedroom 1. Sit on the edge of the bed. Pick up the backpack from the floor. Open the backpack zip. Put the printed lecture notes inside. Put the pencil case inside. Put the notebook inside. Close the backpack zip. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pick up the placement handover notes. Read the handover notes page by page. Put the handover notes into the backpack front pocket. Pick up the phone. Press the screen to wake it. Open the public transport timetable application. Type the destination Monash Clayton campus. Read the bus departure time. Read the bus stop address. Press the back button. Put the phone into his trouser pocket. Pick up the backpack. Carry the backpack to the bedroom door. Place the backpack by the door. Put on his shoes. Tie the shoelaces.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of oats, toast and tea with Member 2, and packing a packed lunch and thermos of tea for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from Bedroom 1 to the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Put the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out the oats packet and the bread. Put the bread in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Pour oats into a bowl. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk. Pour milk over the oats. Put the milk back in the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the boiled kettle. Pour hot water into the teapot. Say to Member 2: 'Morning, breakfast is nearly ready.' Sit down at the kitchen table opposite Member 2. Pick up the spoon. Eat the oats. Take the toast from the toaster. Spread margarine on the toast. Eat the toast. Pour tea into two cups. Push one cup across the table to Member 2. Drink his tea. Stand up. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch container and the thermos. Spoon the cooked rice and vegetables into the lunch container. Close the lunch container lid. Pick up the thermos. Pour the remaining tea into the thermos. Screw the thermos lid on. Put the lunch container and thermos into the backpack. Close the refrigerator door.

enriched_activities.activity: Rinsing his breakfast dishes and clearing his kitchen space
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the kitchen table. Pick up his bowl and cup. Carry them to the kitchen sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowl under the water. Rinse the cup under the water. Put the bowl and cup into the dish rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up a cloth. Wipe the table surface where he ate. Wipe his section of the kitchen bench. Put the cloth back on the hook. Push his chair in under the table. Pick up his backpack from the floor. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying quietly and reading printed lecture notes for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Open the bedroom door. Step inside. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Open the backpack. Take out the printed lecture notes. Take out the notebook and pencil case. Place the notes flat on the desk. Open the notebook to a blank page. Pick up the pen from the pencil case. Read the first section of the lecture notes. Underline a heading in the notes with the pen. Write three key points in the notebook. Turn the page of the lecture notes. Read the second section. Write two more points in the notebook. Pick up the highlighter. Highlight a paragraph in the notes. Put the highlighter down. Turn to the next page of the notes. Read the page. Close the notebook. Put the pen back into the pencil case. Close the pencil case. Stack the lecture notes together. Put the notes, notebook and pencil case back into the backpack. Close the backpack zip.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by bus to the Monash University Clayton campus while reading printed lecture notes
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Pick up the backpack. Walk out of Bedroom 1. Walk down the hallway to the front door. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door behind him. Walk along the footpath to the bus stop. Stop at the bus stop. Take the phone out of his trouser pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into his pocket. Board the bus when it arrives. Tap the travel card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit in an empty seat. Take the lecture notes out of the backpack. Read the notes. Turn one page. Read the next page. Look up at the stop announcement screen. Put the notes back into the backpack. Press the stop request button. Stand up. Walk to the bus door. Get off the bus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Social Work lectures and tutorials, taking detailed handwritten notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the bus stop to the campus building. Open the lecture theatre door. Walk down the steps. Sit in an empty seat in the middle row. Take the notebook and pencil case out of the backpack. Open the notebook on the fold-out desk. Pick up the pen. Write the lecture title and date at the top of the page. Listen to the lecturer and write bullet points in the notebook. Underline a key term. Turn the page. Write a numbered list of practice principles. Raise his hand. Ask the lecturer a question about the placement example. Write down the answer. Turn to the next page. In the tutorial session, move to a group table with four classmates. Push his chair in. Read the tutorial case study sheet handed out. Write notes on the case study sheet margin. Speak to the group: 'Shall we split the tasks so each of us writes one section?' Write the agreed task list in the notebook. Circle the task assigned to him. Gather the notebook and pencil case. Put them into the backpack. Stand up. Push the chair under the table. Walk out of the room.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating a packed flexitarian lunch on campus and drinking tea away from alcohol
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the campus lawn seating area. Sit down on an outdoor bench. Take the lunch container and thermos out of the backpack. Unscrew the thermos lid. Pour tea into the lid cup. Open the lunch container lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the rice and vegetables from the container. Put the fork down. Pick up the lid cup. Drink the tea. Refill the lid cup from the thermos. Drink the tea again. Pick up the fork. Finish the remaining food in the container. Close the lunch container lid. Screw the thermos lid back on. Put the container and thermos into the backpack. Stand up. Walk to the bin. Drop the paper napkin into the rubbish bin. Walk towards the library entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying in the campus library, drafting written assessment work and organising group project tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk through the library entrance gates. Swipe the student card on the turnstile. Walk to the group study floor. Sit down at an empty desk. Take out the notebook, pencil case and laptop. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button. Log in with the password. Open the word processing document for the assessment. Type the essay heading. Read the assessment question sheet. Type the first paragraph. Open the referencing guide in a browser tab. Copy two references into the reference list. Type the second paragraph. Open the shared group project document. Add three task rows to the task table with names and due dates. Type a message in the group chat: 'I have added the task list and due dates.' Close the browser tab. Save the assessment document. Shut down the laptop. Close the laptop lid. Put the laptop, notebook and pencil case into the backpack. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk out of the library.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting by train and bus from campus to the aged-care facility for his support shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the library to the campus train station. Walk onto the platform. Stand behind the yellow line. Take the phone out of his pocket. Check the train departure time. Put the phone back into his pocket. Board the train when it arrives. Sit in an empty seat. Take the handover notes out of the backpack. Read the resident care summary page. Turn to the second page. Read the shift handover procedure page. Put the notes back into the backpack. Stand up at the station. Walk to the train door. Get off the train. Walk downstairs to the bus interchange. Board the bus. Tap the travel card. Remain standing near the door. Get off the bus at the aged-care facility stop. Walk to the facility entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a part-time aged-care support shift: assisting residents with personal care and meals, documenting care notes and following the handover procedure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the facility staff room. Clock in on the time system. Put the backpack into the staff locker. Take out the shift handover notes. Attend the handover briefing with the outgoing staff member. Write down three resident updates on the handover sheet. Walk to the first resident's room. Knock on the door. Open the door. Greet the resident: 'Hello, it's support time, may I help you to the bathroom?' Assist the resident to stand. Hold the resident's arm. Walk with the resident to the bathroom. Help the resident wash hands at the basin. Turn on the tap. Help the resident dry hands with a towel. Turn off the tap. Walk the resident back to the chair. Lower the resident into the chair. Walk to the dining room. Pick up meal trays from the trolley. Push the trolley to the table. Place a tray in front of each resident. Pick up a spoon. Hand the spoon to a resident. Assist one resident with eating. Wipe the table with a cloth. Collect the empty trays. Push the trolley back to the kitchen. Walk to the nurses' station. Sit down at the computer. Open the care notes record. Type the care notes for each resident. Save the record. Log out of the computer. Walk to the staff room. Open the locker. Take out the backpack. Clock out on the time system. Walk to the facility exit.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the facility exit to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of his pocket. Check the bus arrival time. Put the phone back into his pocket. Board the bus. Tap the travel card on the reader. Sit in an empty seat. Take the handover notes out of the backpack. Read the notes for the next shift. Put the notes back into the backpack. Stand up. Walk to the bus door. Get off the bus. Walk to the train station entrance. Walk up the stairs to the platform. Board the train. Sit down. Take out the phone. Open the text message application. Type a text-only message to Member 3: 'On my way home, will eat dinner shortly.' Send the message. Put the phone into his pocket. Stand up at his stop. Walk to the train door. Get off the train. Walk along the footpath to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the front door. Lock the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower and washing up after the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the front door to Bedroom 1. Put the backpack down on the floor. Take the uniform off. Put the uniform into the laundry basket. Walk to the Bathroom. Open the bathroom door. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the shower tap. Test the water temperature with his hand. Turn the tap to adjust it. Step into the shower. Wet his hair and body. Pick up the soap. Lather his body. Rinse off. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into his palm. Wash his hair. Rinse his hair. Turn off the tap. Step out onto the bath mat. Pick up the towel. Dry his hair. Dry his body. Wrap the towel around his waist. Wipe the basin with a cloth. Put the soap back on the dish. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light. Open the door. Walk out of the Bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing tomorrow's lunch and setting out breakfast items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Bathroom to the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetable container and the cooked rice container. Place both containers on the bench. Take out a clean lunch container from the cupboard. Spoon rice into the lunch container. Spoon vegetables into the lunch container. Close the lunch container lid. Put the lunch container into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Open the cupboard door. Take out the oats packet and put it on the bench. Take out a bowl and place it next to the oats. Take out a cup and place it by the kettle. Close the cupboard door. Open the drawer. Take out a spoon and place it beside the bowl. Close the drawer. Wipe the bench with a cloth. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reheating and eating a pre-prepared flexitarian dinner at the kitchen table with Member 3, and drinking a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the Kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the pre-prepared dinner container. Open the microwave door. Place the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. Wait beside the microwave. Open the microwave door when it beeps. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Place the container on the kitchen table. Pull out a chair. Sit down. Say to Member 3: 'How was placement today?' Pick up the fork. Eat the dinner from the container. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Put the cup down. Continue eating. Finish the meal. Stand up. Pick up the container and cup. Carry them to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the container. Rinse the cup. Put the container and cup into the dish rack. Turn off the tap. Wipe the table surface with a cloth. Push the chair under the table. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in his room, reading quietly, sending text-only messages and setting reminders and alarms for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk from the Kitchen to Bedroom 1. Open the bedroom door. Step inside. Close the bedroom door. Turn on the bedroom light. Sit down on the chair at the desk. Pick up the phone. Press the screen to wake it. Open the messages application. Type a text-only message to Member 2: 'Lunch is packed for tomorrow.' Send the message. Press the back button. Open the reminders application. Type a reminder for the library group task. Set the reminder time. Save the reminder. Open the clock application. Set the alarm for 05:40. Set a second alarm for 05:45. Save both alarms. Turn the fan on low. Put the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the book from the bedside table. Open the book to the bookmarked page. Read two pages. Close the book. Put the book back on the bedside table. Press the lamp switch to turn off the bedroom light. Pull the blanket up. Lie down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with the door closed and the fan on low for quiet, uninterrupted rest
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on his back on the bed. Close his eyes. Pull the blanket up to his chest. Turn onto his right side. Place his left arm under the pillow. Breathe slowly and evenly. Turn onto his back. Straighten both legs. Turn onto his left side. Adjust the pillow. Keep the bedroom door closed. Keep the fan running on low. Turn onto his back again. Rest both arms at his sides. Remain in bed with the phone on the bedside table. Continue sleeping until the morning alarm.
